wasm.reason: The selectable Visual Editor draws Wear Compose CMP stand-ins. The read-only Browser Preview is a separate DEVICE surface: CMP Remote M3 records a real .rc document in Wasm and the pinned CMP RcComposePlayer plays it in each selected host frame. Approximate describes authoring only, never the Browser Preview.

native.reason: The generated creation-DSL Kotlin compiled against this module's own alpha Remote Compose trio and rasterised by the real player — the same lane that produces every sticker in this catalog.

frame.$comment_adapter: Not a screen. A Remote Compose widget is drawn into a host container of a fixed size, so the frame is the host, not a watch face: `frame/widget-host` rather than the sibling catalog's `frame/round-screen`. This is the second reason `remote-m3` is a catalog of its own rather than a mode of the Wear one.

geometry.$comment: The two host sizes are DECLARED BY THE PREVIEW CONTRACT, not measured after the fact: remote-catalog/src/main/kotlin/ee/schimke/wearm3catalog/remote/WidgetContainerPreviews.kt pins @Preview(widthDp = 216, heightDp = 76) and (216, 124), being 200x60dp and 200x108dp of content plus 8dp of padding on every edge. Every widget sticker in this catalog renders at one of them, so they are the sizes a builder must offer. Recorded here rather than transcribed into the server, which carried both numbers as constants.

colorTokens.$comment: The theme roles a colour property may name. Same Material 3 vocabulary as the sibling :catalog, and stated here for the same reason: a Remote design names roles, and a role the canvas cannot resolve is a literal. Every sticker in this catalog is a RemoteDocument carrying explicit dark-first Material colours, so the values behind these names are the document's rather than a theme's — but the names are what a design writes.

properties.name: background
properties.notes: The widget's own background, painted by the host inside the frame it draws. Defaults to #FF272430, the colour WearWidgetContainer applies to a widget that declares none. Padding and corner radius are not properties: WearWidgetParams hands them to the widget per host shape (0 rectangular, 26 squircle, 999 round), so the outermost box never authors a radius.

properties.name: themeDisplayTypeface
properties.notes: The font family for the display roles (displayLarge, displayMedium, displaySmall, numeralExtraLarge, numeralLarge, numeralMedium, numeralSmall, numeralExtraSmall) of everything this theme host contains. A family name: one of the editor's vendored faces or any Google Fonts family ("Space Grotesk", "Michroma"); a `google:` prefix is accepted. Generated code sets it as a `GoogleFont` family on the theme's typography. Unset keeps the platform's own face for these roles.

properties.name: themeTextStyle
properties.notes: The type role a text with no `style` of its own is set in, for everything this theme host contains — and with it that role's size and typeface. Both themes default to `bodyLarge`; choose `labelMedium` for a design whose plain text is mostly labels, or a display role for one that is mostly figures. Generated code provides it as `ProvideTextStyle(MaterialTheme.typography.<role>)` inside the theme.

diagnostics.subject: remote-m3/remote-sticker
diagnostics.message: kept off the builder's shelf: the catalog's own preview frame, not a Remote Compose component: every sticker is drawn inside one and nobody places one in a design.

diagnostics.subject: remote-m3/theme-specimen
diagnostics.message: no canvas adapter claimed, so it draws as a placeholder. That is the honest default and needs no fixing; it is reported so a shelf drawn entirely in placeholders is visible rather than mysterious.
